scope: Screen a newly surfaced open-source DWG/DXF implementation for a concrete route, maturity, evidence quality, compatibility, and possible plan use without expanding the build or test dependency set.

method.kind: Public primary-project repository and documentation audit
method.evidenceBoundary: This is a documentation-level candidate screen, not a source audit or reproduced result. Project capability statements are not independent semantic evidence. No local implementation defect or support promotion was established.

observed: The public page describes an MIT-licensed C++20 self-developed DWG/DXF parser and a 2D rendering engine.
The documented route is parser to SceneGraph to renderer to JSON export; no DWG/DXF writer route is documented.
The repository page currently presents no published release entry.
doesNotEstablish: reproducible DWG/DXF parser behavior or a version-complete matrix
writer, graph-roundtrip, binary-DXF, ACIS, or 3D semantic support
evidence.planUse: Keep DISCOVERY_ONLY. Do not add it as a dependency; its documented C++20 requirement also differs from this library's C++14 target. Reconsider only as an optional, separately built 2D display consumer after source and artifact pinning.

evidence.topic: Version fixture status and conflicting completion claims
observed: The version-delta document labels its fixture-status matrix as authoritative and lists AC1015 missing, AC1018/AC1021 partial, AC1024/AC1027 implemented, and AC1032 partial.
The V1.0.0 plan labels broader phases and six version families complete but does not provide a hash-bound run receipt in the reviewed document.
PROJECT_STATUS.md explicitly identifies itself as historical and superseded; it reports earlier partial version coverage and is not treated as current status.
doesNotEstablish: which immutable source/artifact produced each status
exact input hashes, diagnostics, denominator, or independent expected values
semantic agreement with libdxfrw or native CAD acceptance
evidence.planUse: Require a current pinned source/build and per-input evidence receipt before considering peer results. A successful render or JSON export remains display evidence, not parser completeness or graph-preserving conversion evidence.

nextActions: Continue local implementation without installing or running this candidate per slice.
If later selected, pin immutable source/artifact, record input provenance and exact route, and use independent expected geometry for a narrow 2D consumer check.
Keep rendering, parser coverage, graph preservation, file writing, 3D semantics, and native acceptance as separate evidence cells.
Keep all six external-only J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
